title: Copy Focus Deck Data

short.lead: You want Unblock to start with a copy of Focus Deck's data, synced with the same GitHub token, so that editing the copy can never change the original. The Gist (GitHub's hosted sync file) is already safe. The risk is the GitHub issues that tasks are linked to: the copy would still point at the same real issues, so a change in Unblock would show up in Focus Deck.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it does and what it needs from you.
items: Unblock reads and writes only its own sync file, unblock-state.json (app/js/sync.js:10), and only looks for Gists that hold that file (app/js/sync.js:83). It never finds or opens Focus Deck's Gist. Browser storage is kept apart too, and scripts/check-isolation-browser.mjs checks that.
A one-time copy of the Gist

A 'Copy from Focus Deck' button in Unblock's Settings. It reads Focus Deck's Gist without writing to it, then puts that data into a new private Gist that belongs to Unblock. Focus Deck's Gist is never written to.
Paste your GitHub token into Unblock once. It is the same token Focus Deck uses, but Unblock keeps its own stored copy.
Decide what happens to issue links

Some copied tasks are linked to GitHub issues. In Unblock, completing, deleting, relabelling or reprioritising one of those tasks changes the real issue (app/js/github-sync.js:112, 131, 170, 189), and Focus Deck shows that same issue.
Pick option A, B or C in the question below.

changes: Copies Focus Deck's sync data into a new Unblock Gist.

Using your token, it finds Focus Deck's Gist, reads it, and creates a separate private Gist for Unblock. If Unblock already holds data, the copied data is merged with it instead of replacing it. I have not yet checked the name of Focus Deck's sync file, because the Focus Deck repo is not attached to this session. I will read the name from that repo before building.
Unblock starts with every Focus Deck project, task and note.
Focus Deck's Gist is only ever read.
The code that merges synced data (app/js/merge.js) does not change.
choices: What should the copy do with tasks linked to GitHub issues?
Cut the links in the copy

Each copied task keeps its owner/repo#N reference as plain text but is no longer linked to the GitHub issue. Nothing Unblock does can change an issue that Focus Deck shows. You can re-link tasks later, when Unblock replaces Focus Deck.
Copy the links as they are
The Gists stay separate, but both apps use the same GitHub issues, so a change in either app shows up in the other. This only makes sense once Unblock replaces Focus Deck.
Unblock still pulls issues but never writes to them until you turn the switch off. It needs more code to build than option A, and it keeps the shared-issue risk until you turn the switch off.
I recommend option A. It is the only option where an edit in Unblock can never change anything Focus Deck shows, and it is the smallest change.

wrapup.summary: A one-time copy of Focus Deck's sync data into a new Unblock Gist, using the same GitHub token, with Focus Deck's Gist only ever read.
wrapup.changing: Unblock's Settings gains a 'Copy from Focus Deck' button. Focus Deck does not change.
wrapup.blocking: Your pick for linked issues. I also need to read the name of Focus Deck's sync file. For that, the Ajw2003/focus-deck-app repo must be attached to a session.
